text:
neha rao: Quick sync request 1 - we need a compact 'dep-switch' migration playbook for the catalog. Customer pressure around forced swaps + pins is rising. Im proposing: workload-specific bench slices, a small canary lane with KV smoke tests, and a default pin TTL with enterprise opt-up. Thoughts?

sam kim: love the structure. can bench be workload-conditional? e.g., embeddings-only customers shouldn't need chat benches.

neha rao: yes 1 we'll split bench slices by workload type (chat, gen, embeddings). each slice has pass/fail + allowable drift percent and canonical prompts.

maya li: also include hardware labels in bench metadata. models can behave differently on T4 vs A10 - bench results must be device-aware.

jonas peterson: operational risk: KV cache compatibility often causes silent regressions. suggest canary includes a KV cache regression run and automated rollback triggers.

sam kim: agree. canary plan: 0.5-5% traffic split, KV smoke, rollback if err rate >1% or latency P95 increases >20% vs baseline.

leah ortiz: customers asked for: 1) pin option for 90 days; 2) migration credits if swap occurs within 30 days; 3) per-route latency delta visibility. we need thresholds to negotiate.

neha rao: propose default pin TTL 30d, enterprise 90d opt-in. flow: customer requests pin -> run compatibility checks (bench + KV smoke + infra fit) -> business approves -> schedule blackouts/windown.

maya li: bench infra: store prompt sets + golden outputs, compute avg quality score, embed cosine drift, QA hallucination rate. attach model version, quant config, hardware label.

ops-bot: CI: compatibility-smoke (A10, T4) - latest: pass on A10, fail on T4. Logs: https://ci.redwood/5678

jonas peterson: that T4 fail is the exact reason to gate. we either require a compat shim or mark hardware risk. otherwise customers on T4 will see breaks.

sam kim: propose a catalog field `hardware_risk` with values low/medium/high. high requires explicit hw opt-in during rollout.

neha rao: draft launch gates: Bench: workload + device-aware slices with pass/fail and drift thresholds; Canary: small traffic + KV smoke + rollback thresholds; SLA opt-in: for pinned+SLA customers require 90d pin and negotiate migration credits.

leah ortiz: ownership?
- Bench harness/prompt sets: maya li
- Canary infra & rollback automation: jonas peterson
- Pin policy + customer comms: leah ortiz + neha rao

maya li: will assemble initial prompt slices by EOW. need sample prompts from CS & growth.

jonas peterson: will prototype canary infra next sprint: traffic-split automation + KV smoke runner.

leah ortiz: will draft customer-facing matrix + negotiation playbook. aiming for first cut by next Wed.

neha rao: meeting to finalize: Thu 11am. agenda: thresholds, pin TTL options, migration credit formula. bring one exemplar customer case.

sam kim: I'll bring the APAC embed-only customer case.

maya li: sending prompt request to #customer-success now. :mailbox_with_mail:

ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created for Thu 11am.

leah ortiz: quick finance check 1 migration credits formula suggestion: credits = max(100, 0.05 * monthly bill) capped at 10k. okay as baseline?

neha rao: good starting point. we'll loop in finance for sanity check.

sam kim: also add a fallback compatible variant in the rollout plan (quantized variant vs fp16) to allow graceful degradation.

jonas peterson: yes, expose `compatible_variants` on catalog entries and ensure runtime can route fallback.

neha rao: will add `compatible_variants` + `hardware_risk` to the catalog schema draft.

leah ortiz: working doc: https://docs.redwood/sops/dep-switch-playbook-draft (I'll add matrix there).

neha rao: thanks all. will update roadmap ticket and tag owners. ping thread if blockers pop up. :thumbsup:
